overview_description.description: Digival IT Solutions is an education technology company that develops digital transformation software and AI-enabled solutions for higher education institutions. Its products support academic management, assessment automation, curriculum planning, quality assurance, accreditation processes, and learning outcome tracking. The company provides customized platforms designed to align with institutional policies, competency-based education frameworks, and regulatory standards for colleges and universities.

about_short_description.short_description: Digival IT Solutions develops digital learning, assessment, and education management software for higher education institutions.

product.name: DigiAssess
product.description: A digital assessment management system that enables secure, minimal-internet exams to measure course and program learning outcomes.

product.name: DigiClass
product.description: A classroom management system automating attendance and academic scheduling to track curriculum delivery and enhance student engagement.

product.name: H.E.B.A - AI
product.description: An AI-powered platform for higher education that enhances decision-making, resource management, and educational content creation with real-time analytics.

product.name: Q360
product.description: A quality assurance management system for higher education that integrates data sources, streamlines QA processes, and supports compliance and reporting.

product.name: DigiScheduler
product.description: An automated scheduling system that manages academic timetables, resource allocation, and workload monitoring for staff and students.

product.name: DigiLearn
product.description: A learning content management system that automates program workflows, manages staff and student data, and facilitates interactive group discussions and assignments.
